documents.title: About Mark
documents.content: Mark Dave Catubig is an IT student passionate about web development and creating meaningful digital experiences. He specializes in full-stack development, system monitoring, and web applications.

documents.title: SIT-IN Monitoring System Project
documents.content: The SIT-IN MONITORING SYSTEM is a web application that monitors the current used and unused PCs in the laboratory CCS Department. It helps track PC usage and provides real-time monitoring capabilities for laboratory management.

documents.title: Portfolio Website Project
documents.content: A modern, responsive portfolio website showcasing Mark's projects and skills. Features include smooth animations, mobile responsiveness, integrated chatbot with AI capabilities, and contact forms.

documents.title: Mark's Skills
documents.content: Mark's technical skills include HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Web Development, UI/UX Design, and system monitoring. He is proficient in creating responsive web applications and modern user interfaces.
